sekcje: Drug Levels and Effects > Summary of Use during Lactation

No information is available on the use of macitentan during breastfeeding. Because macitentan is more than 99% bound to plasma proteins, the amount in milk is likely to be low. The manufacturer recommends that breastfeeding be discontinued during macitentan therapy. Macitentan and its active metabolite should be completely eliminated from milk in 10 days.
